title: Manuel de Falla: He Brought the Soul of Flamenco to the Concert Hall | 150 Years Ago Today

lines: He brought the soul of flamenco into the concert hall.

scenes.chapter: Chapter 1  A boy by the sea
lines: His mother taught him piano,
and he grew up hearing the folk songs of the port.
In 1905, his opera Life Is Short
In nineteen oh five, his opera, Life Is Short,

In 1907, with little money, he moved to Paris,
In nineteen oh seven, with little money, he moved to Paris,
where Debussy and Ravel became his friends.
They urged him to write music that was truly Spanish.
When war broke out in 1914, he went home to Madrid.
When war broke out in nineteen fourteen, he went home to Madrid.
In 1915, he wrote the ballet Love, the Magician,
In nineteen fifteen, he wrote the ballet, Love, the Magician,
with its Ritual Fire Dance, as fierce as leaping flames.
In 1919, The Three-Cornered Hat opened in London,
In nineteen nineteen, his ballet, The Three-Cornered Hat, opened in London,
with sets and costumes by Pablo Picasso.
Later he moved south to Granada, near the Alhambra,
worried that the ancient deep song was dying out.
In 1922, with the young poet Lorca,
In nineteen twenty-two, with the young poet Lorca,
he held a deep song contest at the Alhambra.
In 1939, he left Spain for Argentina,
In nineteen thirty-nine, he left Spain for Argentina,
and died there in 1946, his last work unfinished.
and died there in nineteen forty-six, his last work unfinished.
He showed the world that folk song can become great music.
His question for you:
Which old song from your home deserves to be heard?
